SELECT DAH.STDR_MT ,DAH.CUSTOMER_CODE ,DAH.ATTRIBUTE01 ,DAH.SLE_PRIC_DOC ,DAH.SLE_PRIC_DOC_PRDLST ,DAH.COMPANY_CODE ,DAH.DIVISION_CODE ,DAH.ITEM_CODE ,DAH.CSTMR_ITEM ,DAH.PRIC_RQEST_DATE ,DAH.JDGMNT_TYPE ,DAH.XPORT_AT ,DAH.SA_SE ,DAH.ITEM_NM ,DAH.ITEM_GROUP ,DAH.DRWBAK_SE_CODE ,DAH.GOODS_AT ,DAH.BASS_UNIT ,DAH.REAL_PRIC_RQEST_QY ,DAH.ACPLC_CRNCY_AMOUNT ,DAH.STTEMNT_PC_KRW ,DAH.DRWBAK_AMOUNT ,DAH.DRWBAK_DDC_AMOUNT ,DAH.DRWBAK_TRMMG_AMOUNT ,DAH.HS_CODE ,DAH.NATION_CODE ,DAH.ACPLC_CRNCY ,DAH.KRW_CRNCY ,DAH.EXECUT_AT ,DAH.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO ,DAH.XPORT_SE ,DAH.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO ,DAH.LNE_NO ,DAH.ROW1 ,DAH.DSPTH_DATE ,DAH.TRNSMIS_ID ,DAH.REF_GU_ID FROM DRWBAK_AMOUNT_HDER DAH WHERE 1=1
AND DAH.STDR_MT >= REPLACE(#{STDR_MT}, '-', '')
AND DAH.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND DAH.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND DAH.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND DAH.SLE_PRIC_DOC = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND DAH.SLE_PRIC_DOC LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND DAH.SLE_PRIC_DOC LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND DAH.CUSTOMER_CODE = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND DAH.CUSTOMER_CODE LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND DAH.CUSTOMER_CODE LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'

SELECT DCI.PRESENTN_NO ,DCI.SEQ ,DCI.STDR_MT ,DCI.CUSTOMER_CODE ,DCI.CUSTOMER_NM ,DCI.SLE_PRIC_DOC ,DCI.SLE_PRIC_DOC_PRDLST ,DCI.COMPANY_CODE ,DCI.DIVISION_CODE ,DCI.ITEM_CODE ,DCI.CSTMR_ITEM ,DCI.JDGMNT_TYPE ,DCI.XPORT_AT ,DCI.SA_SE ,DCI.ITEM_NM ,DCI.XPORT_SE ,DCI.ITEM_GROUP ,DCI.DRWBAK_SE_CODE ,DCI.HS_CODE ,DCI.DRWBAK_AMOUNT ,DCI.DRWBAK_DDC_AMOUNT ,DCI.DRWBAK_TRMMG_AMOUNT ,DCI.ACPLC_CRNCY ,DCI.DRWBAK_SEQ ,DCI.REGIST_RCEPT_NO ,DCI.DCSN_DATE ,DCI.EXECUT_AT ,DCI.GOODS_AT ,DCI.PRFLOS_CNTER ,DCI.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO ,DCI.LNE_NO ,DCI.ROW1 ,DCI.DSPTH_DATE ,DCI.NATION_CODE ,DCI.DELETE_DRCTR ,DCI.GU_ID_NO FROM DRWBAK_CTRM_ISSU DCI WHERE DCI.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE}
AND DCI.STDR_MT >= REPLACE(#{SEARCH_STDR_MT}, '-', '')
AND DCI.PRESENTN_NO = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND DCI.PRESENTN_NO LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND DCI.PRESENTN_NO LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND DCI.DSPTH_DATE BETWEEN REPLACE(#{SEARCH_RCEPT_FROM_DATE}, '-', '') AND REPLACE(#{SEARCH_RCEPT_TO_DATE}, '-', '')
AND DCI.DSPTH_DATE >= REPLACE(#{SEARCH_RCEPT_FROM_DATE}, '-', '')
AND DCI.DSPTH_DATE <= REPLACE(#{SEARCH_RCEPT_TO_DATE}, '-', '')
AND DCI.DSPTH_DATE BETWEEN REPLACE(#{SEARCH_DSPTH_FROM_DATE}, '-', '') AND REPLACE(#{SEARCH_DSPTH_TO_DATE}, '-', '')
AND DCI.DSPTH_DATE >= REPLACE(#{SEARCH_DSPTH_FROM_DATE}, '-', '')
AND DCI.DSPTH_DATE <= REPLACE(#{SEARCH_DSPTH_TO_DATE}, '-', '')

SELECT RIL.GU_ID_NO ,RIL.SEQ ,RIL.SUB_SEQ ,RIL.EFECT_BGNDE ,RIL.ITEM_CODE ,RIL.COMPANY_CODE ,RIL.STDR_MT ,RIL.ITEM_NM ,RIL.HS_CODE ,RIL.RAWMTRL_SE ,RIL.IMPDEC_NO ,RIL.LNE_NO ,RIL.POUCH_NO ,RIL.QY ,RIL.CSTMS ,RIL.CSTMS_AMOUNT ,RIL.CSTMS_AMOUNT_UNIT ,RIL.DLIVY_QY ,RIL.DLIVY_AMOUNT ,RIL.BASS_UNIT ,RIL.ACPLC_CRNCY ,RIL.INCME_THNG_ID FROM RAWMTRL_INCME_LOCAL_SM RIL WHERE 1=1
AND RIL.STDR_MT >= REPLACE(#{STDR_MT}, '-', '')

SELECT IDH.GU_ID, IDH.STDR_MT, IDH.CUSTOMER_CODE, IDH.SLE_PRIC_DOC, IDH.SLE_PRIC_DOC_PRDLST, IDH.COMPANY_CODE, IDH.DIVISION_CODE, IDH.ITEM_CODE, IDH.CSTMR_ITEM, IDH.JDGMNT_TYPE, IDH.PRIC_RQEST_DATE, IDH.XPORT_AT, IDH.SA_SE, IDH.DISTB_COURS, IDH.ITEM_GROUP, IDH.DRWBAK_SE_CODE, IDH.GOODS_AT, IDH.HS_CODE, IDH.NATION_CODE, IDH.DRWBAK_AMOUNT, IDH.DRWBAK_TRMMG_AMOUNT, IDH.BASS_UNIT, IDH.STDR_QY, IDH.REAL_PRIC_RQEST_QY, IDH.ACPLC_CRNCY_AMOUNT, IDH.DELY_CND, IDH.STATUS, IDH.ACPLC_CRNCY, IDH.KRW_CRNCY, IDH.PRFLOS_CNTER, IDH.XPORT_SE, IDH.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO, IDH.LNE_NO, IDH.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO, IDH.ROW1, IDH.DSPTH_DATE, IDH.STTEMNT_PC_KRW, IDH.INCME_DOC_NO, IDH.INCME_DOC_LNE_NO, IDH.BASIS_QY, IDH.GU_ID_NO, IDH.BOM_CHANGE_DATE, IDH.BOM_CTGRY, IDH.BOM_SE, IDH.ALTRTV_BOM, IDH.REQREQY_CALC_MTH, IDH.MSSAGE_TYPE, IDH.MSSAGE_TEXT, IDH.SELNG_MASTR_KEY, IDH.PURCHS_LEDGR_KEY, IDH.MTRIL_RCVPAY_KEY, IDH.STD_BOM_HIST_HDER_KEY, IDH.STD_BOM_HIST_ITEM_KEY, IDH.DRWBAK_AMOUNT_HDER_KEY FROM INPUT_DATA_HDER IDH WHERE 1 = 1
AND IDH.STDR_MT = SUBSTR(REPLACE(#{CAL_SEARCH_DATE}, '-', ''),1,6)

SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_CODE, A.PRESENTN_NO, A.THNG_SEQ, A.ITEM_CODE, A.ITEM_NM, A.THNG_SE, A.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO, A.LNE_NO, A.POUCH_NO, A.DSPTH_DATE, A.ACCMLT_ORDER_QY, A.BASS_UNIT, TRUNC(A.STTEMNT_PC_KRW, 0) AS STTEMNT_PC_KRW, A.KRW_CRNCY, A.DIVISION_CODE FROM (SELECT T.ITEM_CODE, T.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO, T.LNE_NO, T.POUCH_NO, T.DSPTH_DATE, T.ACCMLT_ORDER_QY, T.BASS_UNIT, TRUNC(T.STTEMNT_PC_KRW) AS STTEMNT_PC_KRW, T.THNG_SEQ, CASE WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = A.BASS_UNIT THEN A.USGQTY ELSE (CASE WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'KG' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'LB' THEN A.USGQTY / 0.453592 / 1000 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'DR' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 / 30 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'GR' THEN A.USGQTY / 0.064799 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'MT' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 / 1000 ELSE B.QY END) END AS USGQTY, T.DIVISION_CODE, T.KRW_CRNCY, T.THNG_SE, T.ITEM_NM, T.PRESENTN_NO, T.COMPANY_CODE FROM DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_TRGET_THNG T INNER JOIN DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_INCME_RAWMTRL A ON T.COMPANY_CODE = A.COMPANY_CODE AND T.PRESENTN_NO = A.PRESENTN_NO AND T.THNG_SEQ = A.THNG_SEQ INNER JOIN INCME_LOCAL_BNT_SM B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.RAWMTRL_CODE = B.ITEM_CODE AND A.LNE_NO = B.LNE_NO AND A.POUCH_NO = B.POUCH_NO AND A.IMPDEC_NO = B.IMPDEC_NO
WHERE TRUNC(A.CSTMS, 4) > 0 AND T.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND T.PRESENTN_NO = #{P_PRESENTN_NO} AND T.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} ORDER BY XPORT_STTEMNT_NO, LNE_NO, POUCH_NO) A WHERE TRUNC(USGQTY, 3) > 0.000999999999999 ORDER BY A.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO, A.LNE_NO, A.POUCH_NO

SELECT A.COMPANY_CODE, A.PRESENTN_NO, A.THNG_SEQ, A.RAWMTRL_SEQ, A.ITEM_CODE, A.RAWMTRL_CODE, A.ITEM_NM, A.HS_CODE, A.RAWMTRL_SE, A.IMPDEC_NO, A.LNE_NO, A.POUCH_NO, A.ACPT_DATE, A.USGQTY, A.BASS_UNIT, A.CSTMS, A.INTTAX, A.ECX_AMOUNT, A.AGSPT, A.DDC_RATE_PRDCTN, TRUNC(A.DRWBAK_AMOUNT, 0) AS DRWBAK_AMOUNT, A.ACPLC_CRNCY, A.TRGET_AT FROM DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_INCME_RAWMTRL A INNER JOIN (SELECT AA.COMPANY_CODE ,AA.PRESENTN_NO ,(CASE WHEN BB.IMP_BASS_UNIT = AA.BASS_UNIT THEN AA.USGQTY ELSE (CASE WHEN BB.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'KG' THEN AA.USGQTY / 1000 WHEN BB.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'LB' THEN AA.USGQTY / 0.453592 / 1000 WHEN BB.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'DR' THEN AA.USGQTY / 1000 / 30 WHEN BB.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'GR' THEN AA.USGQTY / 0.064799 WHEN BB.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'MT' THEN AA.USGQTY / 1000 / 1000 ELSE BB.QY END) END) AS USGQTY ,AA.THNG_SEQ ,AA.RAWMTRL_SEQ FROM DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_INCME_RAWMTRL AA INNER JOIN DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_CMMN RC ON RC.COMPANY_CODE = AA.COMPANY_CODE AND RC.PRESENTN_NO = AA.PRESENTN_NO INNER JOIN INCME_LOCAL_BNT_SM BB ON AA.COMPANY_CODE = BB.COMPANY_CODE AND AA.RAWMTRL_CODE = BB.ITEM_CODE AND AA.LNE_NO = BB.LNE_NO AND AA.POUCH_NO = BB.POUCH_NO AND AA.IMPDEC_NO = BB.IMPDEC_NO WHERE TRUNC(AA.CSTMS, 4) > 0 AND AA.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND AA.PRESENTN_NO = #{PRESENTN_NO} AND AA.THNG_SEQ = #{THNG_SEQ} ) B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.PRESENTN_NO = B.PRESENTN_NO AND A.THNG_SEQ = B.THNG_SEQ AND A.RAWMTRL_SEQ = B.RAWMTRL_SEQ WHERE TRUNC(B.USGQTY, 3) > 0.000999999999999 AND A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.PRESENTN_NO = #{PRESENTN_NO} AND A.THNG_SEQ = #{THNG_SEQ}

SELECT COMPANY_CODE, POUCH_NO, IMPDEC_NO ||'-' || LPAD(LNE_NO,3,'0') || '-' || LPAD(POUCH_NO,2,'0') AS IMPDEC_LP_NO, ACPT_DATE, RAWMTRL_CODE, SUM(USGQTY) AS USGQTY FROM DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_INCME_RAWMTRL A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.PRESENTN_NO = #{P_PRESENTN_NO} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DRWBAK_LMTT_REGLTN DLR WHERE DLR.COMPANY_CODE = A.COMPANY_CODE AND DLR.DRWBAK_LMTT_REGLTN ='1' AND A.ACPT_DATE BETWEEN DLR.EFECT_BGNDE AND DLR.EFECT_ENDDE AND A.HS_CODE = DLR.HS_CODE ) GROUP BY COMPANY_CODE, POUCH_NO, IMPDEC_NO ||'-' || LPAD(LNE_NO,3,'0') || '-' || LPAD(POUCH_NO,2,'0'), ACPT_DATE, RAWMTRL_CODE

SELECT LST.LNE_NO ,LST.POUCH_NO ,LST.HS_CODE ,LST.ITEM_CODE ,LST.ITEM_NM ,LST.ITEM_QTY ,LST.SLE_UNIT ,LST.STTEMNT_PC_KRW ,LST.INV_NO ,LST.FAIL_REASON_CODE ,CC.CODE_NM ,LST.CREATE_DATE ,LST.UPDATE_DATE ,LST.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO ,LST.MANUFAC_NAME ,LST.XPORT_SE FROM (SELECT A.LNE_NO ,A.POUCH_NO ,A.HS_CODE ,A.ITEM_CODE ,A.ITEM_NM ,A.ITEM_QTY ,A.SLE_UNIT ,A.STTEMNT_PC_KRW ,A.INV_NO ,B.PRESENTN_NO ,ECR.FAIL_REASON_CODE ,TO_CHAR(ECR.CREATE_DATE, 'RRRRMMDD') AS CREATE_DATE ,TO_CHAR(ECR.UPDATE_DATE, 'RRRRMMDD') AS UPDATE_DATE ,A.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO ,A.MANUFAC_NAME ,A.XPORT_SE FROM EXPORT_CERT_MST A LEFT OUTER JOIN DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_TRGET_THNG B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = B.DIVISION_CODE AND A.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO = B.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO AND A.LNE_NO = B.LNE_NO AND A.POUCH_NO = B.POUCH_NO AND A.ITEM_CODE = B.ITEM_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN EXPORT_CONFIRM_REASON ECR ON ECR.COMPANY_CODE = A.COMPANY_CODE AND ECR.DIVISION_CODE = A.DIVISION_CODE AND ECR.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO = A.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO AND ECR.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO = A.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO AND ECR.LNE_NO = A.LNE_NO AND ECR.POUCH_NO = A.POUCH_NO AND ECR.ITEM_CODE = A.ITEM_CODE WHERE A.HS_CODE IS NOT NULL AND A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{P_DIVISION_CODE} AND A.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO = #{P_EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO} AND A.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO = #{P_XPORT_STTEMNT_NO} AND A.HS_CODE = #{P_HS_CODE}) LST LEFT OUTER JOIN COM_CD CC ON CC.CATEGORY_CD = 'CFRSN' AND CC.CODE_CD = LST.FAIL_REASON_CODE
WHERE PRESENTN_NO IS NOT NULL
WHERE PRESENTN_NO IS NULL
mapper.update: INSERT INTO DRWBAK_CONFIRM_TEMP (MY_KEY,XPORT_STTEMNT_NO,HS_CODE,MANUFAC_NAME,XPORT_SE) VALUES (#{MY_KEY}, #{XPORT_STTEMNT_NO}, #{HS_CODE}, #{MANUFAC_NAME}, #{XPORT_SE})

INSERT INTO DRWBAK_CONFIRM_TEMP (MY_KEY,XPORT_STTEMNT_NO,HS_CODE,MANUFAC_NAME,XPORT_SE) SELECT DISTINCT #{MY_KEY}, XPORT_STTEMNT_NO, HS_CODE, MAX(MANUFAC_NAME) AS MANUFAC_NAME, XPORT_SE FROM (SELECT A.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO, A.HS_CODE, A.MANUFAC_NAME, A.CRNCY, A.XPORT_SE, AA.REGIST_RCEPT_NO FROM EXPORT_CERT_MST A LEFT OUTER JOIN DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_TRGET_THNG B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = B.DIVISION_CODE AND A.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO = B.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO AND A.LNE_NO = B.LNE_NO AND A.POUCH_NO = B.POUCH_NO AND A.ITEM_CODE = B.ITEM_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_CMMN AA ON A.COMPANY_CODE = AA.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = AA.DIVISION_CODE AND B.PRESENTN_NO = AA.PRESENTN_NO WHERE A.DSPTH_DATE LIKE #{TARGET_MONTH}||'%'
AND A.XPORT_SE IN ('11','17','31')
AND (A.RQST_PRSN_CODE = '1' OR (A.MANUFAC_NAME = '(주)아모레퍼시픽' AND A.RQST_PRSN_CODE = '2') )
AND A.RQST_PRSN_CODE = '1'
AND A.HS_CODE IS NOT NULL AND A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} AND B.PRESENTN_NO IS NULL
) LST WHERE REGIST_RCEPT_NO IS NULL GROUP BY XPORT_STTEMNT_NO,HS_CODE,XPORT_SE
DELETE FROM DRWBAK_CONFIRM_TEMP WHERE MY_KEY = #{MY_KEY}
DELETE FROM DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_TRGET_TEMP WHERE PRESENTN_NO = #{KEY_PRESENTN_NO}

SELECT DISTINCT LST.COMPANY_CODE, LST.DIVISION_CODE, LST.DRWBAK_MONTH, LST.HS_CODE, LST.MANUFAC_NAME, LST.XPORT_TYPE FROM (SELECT A.*, SUBSTR(A.DSPTH_DATE, 1, 6) AS DRWBAK_MONTH, (CASE WHEN B.PRESENTN_NO IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) AS CONFIRM_YN, AA.REGIST_RCEPT_NO FROM EXPORT_CERT_MST A LEFT OUTER JOIN DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_TRGET_THNG B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = B.DIVISION_CODE AND A.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO = B.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO AND A.LNE_NO = B.LNE_NO AND A.POUCH_NO = B.POUCH_NO AND A.ITEM_CODE = B.ITEM_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_CMMN AA ON A.COMPANY_CODE = AA.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = AA.DIVISION_CODE AND B.PRESENTN_NO = AA.PRESENTN_NO WHERE 1=1 AND A.HS_CODE IS NOT NULL AND A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE}
AND A.XPORT_SE IN ('11','17','31')
AND (A.RQST_PRSN_CODE = '1' OR (A.MANUFAC_NAME = '(주)아모레퍼시픽' AND A.RQST_PRSN_CODE = '2') )
AND A.RQST_PRSN_CODE = '1'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DRWBAK_CONFIRM_TEMP X WHERE X.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO = A.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO AND X.HS_CODE = A.HS_CODE AND X.MANUFAC_NAME = A.MANUFAC_NAME AND X.XPORT_SE = A.XPORT_SE AND X.MY_KEY = #{MY_KEY}) ) LST WHERE REGIST_RCEPT_NO IS NULL AND LST.CONFIRM_YN = 'N' ORDER BY DRWBAK_MONTH

SELECT MIN(CASE WHEN (SELECT SUM(AA.REMNDR_QY) AS QTY_POOL FROM INCME_LOCAL_BNT_SM AA WHERE AA.EFECT_BGNDE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(REQ.DSPTH_DATE, 'RRRRMMDD'))+1, -24), 'RRRRMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(REQ.DSPTH_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')-1,'YYYYMMDD') AND AA.ITEM_CODE = A.ITEM_CODE AND AA.REMNDR_QY > 0 AND AA.COMPANY_CODE = A.COMPANY_CODE AND AA.DIVISION_CODE = A.DIVISION_CODE /* START : 환급 제한 규정 */ AND AA.HS_CODE NOT IN (SELECT X.HS_CODE FROM DRWBAK_LMTT_REGLTN X WHERE X.COMPANY_CODE = A.COMPANY_CODE) /* END : 환급 제한 규정 */) >= (A.INPUT_QTY * REQ.ACCMLT_ORDER_QY) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS POOL_YN FROM RESULT_BOM_AP A INNER JOIN DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_TRGET_TEMP REQ ON A.COMPANY_CODE = REQ.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = REQ.DIVISION_CODE AND A.PRODUCT_CODE = REQ.ITEM_CODE AND REQ.PRESENTN_NO = #{KEY_PRESENTN_NO} AND REQ.THNG_SEQ = ${THNG_SEQ} WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.INPUT_QTY > 0 AND A.BOM_VERSION = (SELECT MAX(A.BOM_VERSION) FROM RESULT_BOM_AP A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} AND A.PRODUCT_CODE = REQ.ITEM_CODE AND A.BOM_VERSION < REQ.DSPTH_DATE)

SELECT CASE WHEN TRUNC(MAX(A.MAKE_ABLE_COUNT), 0) >= ACCMLT_ORDER_QY THEN ACCMLT_ORDER_QY ELSE TRUNC(MAX(A.MAKE_ABLE_COUNT), 0) END AS TGT_ACCMLT_ORDER_QY FROM (SELECT A.PRODUCT_CODE, A.ITEM_CODE, A.INPUT_QTY, SUM(SM.REMNDR_QY) / A.INPUT_QTY AS MAKE_ABLE_COUNT, REQ.ACCMLT_ORDER_QY FROM RESULT_BOM_AP A INNER JOIN DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_TRGET_TEMP REQ ON A.COMPANY_CODE = REQ.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = REQ.DIVISION_CODE AND A.PRODUCT_CODE = REQ.ITEM_CODE AND REQ.PRESENTN_NO = #{KEY_PRESENTN_NO} AND REQ.THNG_SEQ = ${THNG_SEQ} INNER JOIN INCME_LOCAL_BNT_SM SM ON A.COMPANY_CODE = SM.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = SM.DIVISION_CODE AND SM.EFECT_BGNDE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(REQ.DSPTH_DATE, 'RRRRMMDD'))+1, -24), 'RRRRMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(REQ.DSPTH_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')-1,'YYYYMMDD') AND SM.ITEM_CODE = A.ITEM_CODE AND SM.REMNDR_QY > 0 AND SM.CSTMS > 0 /* START : 환급 제한 규정 */ AND SM.HS_CODE NOT IN (SELECT X.HS_CODE FROM DRWBAK_LMTT_REGLTN X WHERE X.COMPANY_CODE = SM.COMPANY_CODE) /* END : 환급 제한 규정 */ WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.INPUT_QTY > 0 AND A.BOM_VERSION = (SELECT MAX(A.BOM_VERSION) FROM RESULT_BOM_AP A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} AND A.PRODUCT_CODE = REQ.ITEM_CODE AND A.BOM_VERSION < REQ.DSPTH_DATE ) GROUP BY A.PRODUCT_CODE,A.ITEM_CODE,A.INPUT_QTY,REQ.ACCMLT_ORDER_QY) A GROUP BY ACCMLT_ORDER_QY

SELECT NVL(MAX(A.THNG_SEQ), 0) AS PRE_THNG_SEQ_NUMBER FROM DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_TRGET_THNG A WHERE A.PRESENTN_NO = #{KEY_PRESENTN_NO} AND A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE}

mapper.update: MERGE INTO EXPORT_CERT_MST A USING (SELECT COMPANY_CODE ,ITEM_CODE ,XPORT_STTEMNT_NO ,LNE_NO ,POUCH_NO ,NVL(#{TGT_ACCMLT_ORDERQTY},0) AS ACCMLT_ORDER_QY /*,ACCMLT_ORDER_QY [2020.05.18 : 가능한수량만큼 만들기*/ ,DIVISION_CODE FROM DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_TRGET_TEMP A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.PRESENTN_NO = #{KEY_PRESENTN_NO} AND A.THNG_SEQ = ${THNG_SEQ} ) B ON (A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = B.DIVISION_CODE AND A.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO = B.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO AND A.LNE_NO = B.LNE_NO AND A.POUCH_NO = B.POUCH_NO AND A.ITEM_CODE = B.ITEM_CODE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.ABLE_ITEM_QTY = (A.ABLE_ITEM_QTY - B.ACCMLT_ORDER_QY) ,A.USED_ITEM_QTY = (NVL(A.USED_ITEM_QTY,0) - NVL(B.ACCMLT_ORDER_QY,0))

MERGE INTO ADAMT_PAMT_DOC_HDR T USING ( SELECT #{COMPANY_CODE} AS COMPANY_CODE ,#{DIVISION_CODE} AS DIVISION_CODE ,#{KEY_PRESENTN_NO} AS PRESENTN_NO ,C.BANK_CODE ,BM.BANK_NM ,C.ACNUTNO ,C.COMPANY_NM AS RCEPT_COMPANY_NAME ,C.RPRSNTV_NM AS RCEPT_RPRSNTV_NM ,C.ECTMRK ,C.BIZRNO ,C.ADRES AS ADDRESS ,'GOVCBRDCK' AS STTEMNT_DOC_STLE ,#{CSTBRKR} AS CSTBRKR FROM COMPANY C LEFT OUTER JOIN BANK_MST BM ON BM.COMPANY_CODE = C.COMPANY_CODE AND BM.BANK_CODE = C.BANK_CODE AND BM.ACNUTNO = C.ACNUTNO WHERE C.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} ) P ON (P.COMPANY_CODE = T.COMPANY_CODE AND P.DIVISION_CODE = T.DIVISION_CODE AND P.PRESENTN_NO = T.PRESENTN_NO) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(COMPANY_CODE, DIVISION_CODE, PRESENTN_NO, BANK_CODE, BANK_NM, ACNUTNO, RCEPT_COMPANY_NAME, RCEPT_RPRSNTV_NM, ECTMRK, BIZRNO, ADDRESS, STTEMNT_DOC_STLE, CSTBRKR) VALUES(P.COMPANY_CODE, P.DIVISION_CODE, P.PRESENTN_NO, P.BANK_CODE, P.BANK_NM, P.ACNUTNO, P.RCEPT_COMPANY_NAME, P.RCEPT_RPRSNTV_NM, P.ECTMRK, P.BIZRNO, P.ADDRESS, P.STTEMNT_DOC_STLE, P.CSTBRKR)
mapper.update: MERGE INTO ADAMT_PAMT_DOC_HDR T USING ( SELECT A.COMPANY_CODE ,A.DIVISION_CODE ,A.PRESENTN_NO ,SUM(CASE WHEN A.TAX_TYPE = '111' THEN TRUNC(A.ADAMT,-1) ELSE 0 END) AS CSTMS ,SUM(CASE WHEN A.TAX_TYPE = '522' THEN TRUNC(A.ADAMT,-1) ELSE 0 END) AS INTTAX ,SUM(CASE WHEN A.TAX_TYPE = '611' THEN TRUNC(A.ADAMT,-1) ELSE 0 END) AS TRANTAX ,SUM(CASE WHEN A.TAX_TYPE = '531' THEN TRUNC(A.ADAMT,-1) ELSE 0 END) AS LQTX_AMOUNT ,SUM(CASE WHEN A.TAX_TYPE = '621' THEN TRUNC(A.ADAMT,-1) ELSE 0 END) AS ECX_AMOUNT ,SUM(CASE WHEN A.TAX_TYPE = '631' THEN TRUNC(A.ADAMT,-1) ELSE 0 END) AS AGSPT ,SUM(TRUNC(A.ADAMT,-1)) AS TOT_TAX FROM ADAMT_PAMT_DOC_ITEM A WHERE A.PRESENTN_NO = #{PRESENTN_NO} AND A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} GROUP BY A.COMPANY_CODE ,A.DIVISION_CODE ,A.PRESENTN_NO ) P ON (P.COMPANY_CODE = T.COMPANY_CODE AND P.DIVISION_CODE = T.DIVISION_CODE AND P.PRESENTN_NO = T.PRESENTN_NO) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.CSTMS = P.CSTMS ,T.INTTAX= P.INTTAX ,T.ECX_AMOUNT = P.ECX_AMOUNT ,T.AGSPT = P.AGSPT ,T.TRANTAX = P.TRANTAX ,T.LQTX_AMOUNT = P.LQTX_AMOUNT ,T.TOT_TAX = P.TOT_TAX
